prompts.lotus: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE transparent game prop for an original tranquil shallow jade pond, natural photographic botanical fidelity, strict orthographic 90-degree TOP DOWN, NOT isometric. Subject: three overlapping rounded fresh muted sage-green water-lily pads with fine radiating veins and natural subtle edge notches, ONE small ivory-blush pink water lily flower offset near the center. Natural, understated, sunlit from upper left with very soft short contact shading confined to objects. Entire cluster isolated, centered in square canvas, 10 percent transparent margin, no stems hanging down, no water, no ground, no text, no labels, no decorative frame, no black or white matte, no cast shadow stretching outside cluster. Fine organic soft textures, not low-poly, not plastic, not flat cartoon, not huge luminous pink blossom. This is a reusable top-down sprite to composite over a pale green shallow pool; preserve authentic transparent alpha.
prompts.reeds: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE transparent TOP-DOWN orthographic 90-degree game prop: a small natural waterside reed and sedge tuft rooted among three smooth warm gray pebbles. A loose irregular asymmetrical cluster, thin curved sage and olive blades radiating outward, just two restrained tawny seed heads, whole plant visible FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE (no horizon, no side elevation, no isometric view). Original photographic botanical detail, soft sun from upper left, natural subdued jade-pool palette. Centered square with 12 percent empty transparent margin. No water, no patch of ground, no enclosing circular base, no pot, no disk, no text, no border, no artificial flat polygons, no plastic, no broad black shadow. Fully transparent background with crisp natural antialiased alpha, soft tiny contact shadows only between overlapping objects.
prompts.rock: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE transparent top-down game prop: an asymmetrical cluster of THREE smooth wet river stones, one medium rounded gray-green stone, one smaller warm gray flat stone and one tiny pebble, faint sparse moss only in the crevice. Strict 90-degree overhead orthographic view, no perspective horizon. Natural photographic mineral grain, subtle wet highlights, smooth organic contours, pale soft sunlight upper-left, muted warm gray and sage tones for a tranquil pale jade shallow pond. Centered square, entire cluster visible with 12 percent transparent margin. No ground, no water, no sand disk, no grass bed, no frame, no text, no black/white matte, no faceted low-poly modeling, no plastic. Genuine transparent background and unobtrusive contact shadow confined close to stone edges.
